cases.original_claim: Q1 2026 Brand Suitability Violation Rate was 3.7 points in North America and 8.0 points in APAC.
cases.source_anchor: Brand Suitability Violation Rate: North America 3.7%; APAC 8.0%.
cases.source_truth: The source reports percentages, not points: 3.7% in North America and 8.0% in APAC for Q1 2026.

cases.original_claim: Q1 2026 In-App Video Attention Index was 131 in North America, 130 in EMEA, and 128 in APAC.
cases.source_anchor: Attention Index by Regions lists In-App Video as 131 APAC, 130 EMEA, and 128 North America.
cases.source_truth: The values are geographically bound: APAC 131, EMEA 130, North America 128.

cases.original_claim: 43% of consumers now accept real-time payments.
cases.source_anchor: 43% of merchants now accept real-time payments.
cases.source_truth: The population is merchants, not consumers; the report's survey context is 1,200+ eCommerce merchants.

cases.original_claim: 63% of merchants currently use agentic AI payments.
cases.source_anchor: 63% of merchants are actively exploring or plan to implement agentic AI payments in the near future.
cases.source_truth: The source describes exploration or planned implementation in the near future, not current use.

cases.original_claim: 68% of global respondents said shoppers are more likely to convert using AI tools.
cases.source_anchor: Agreement that shoppers are more likely to convert ranges from 68% in the United States to 57% in New Zealand and Australia.
cases.source_truth: The 68% figure is the United States result, not a global respondent result.

cases.original_claim: For 2015–20, market-value-growth shares were 52% born tech, 20% tech-led strategy, and 38% other.
cases.source_anchor: The chart labels market-value-growth shares as 52% born tech, 20% tech-led strategy, and 28% other.
cases.source_truth: The chart components total 100%: 52% born tech, 20% tech-led strategy, and 28% other.

cases.original_claim: The preferred-wallet requirement causes shoppers to abandon carts, proving wallet choice is the main checkout driver.
cases.source_anchor: 40% have abandoned a cart after finding they cannot use their preferred wallet method.
cases.source_truth: The source supports an observed 40% abandonment response and does not establish sole causation or that wallet choice is the main checkout driver.

cases.original_claim: 40% of shoppers abandoned a cart after finding they could not use their preferred wallet method.
cases.source_anchor: 40% have abandoned a cart after finding they cannot use their preferred wallet method.
cases.source_truth: The preferred-wallet finding is on physical page 4; page 8 is unrelated and must not rescue this strict wrong-page claim.

cases.original_claim: Q2 2026 Brand Suitability Violation Rate was 3.7% in North America and 8.0% in APAC.
cases.source_anchor: The page is headed Global Quality Benchmarks | Q1 2026 and lists North America 3.7% and APAC 8.0%.
cases.source_truth: The reported period is Q1 2026; the source does not support Q2 2026.
